title: Repeated expensive expression that could be stored in a variable
rationale: Variables can improve readability and may avoid repeated evaluation of the same expression.
review_note: Do not rewrite trivial expressions solely to satisfy the rule.

title: FILTER used as a filter argument where a Boolean filter is possible
rationale: Microsoft recommends Boolean filter arguments when possible for better efficiency.
review_note: FILTER is required for complex table expressions and measure-based predicates.

title: Division implemented with / where DIVIDE would safely handle zero/blank denominator
rationale: DIVIDE can simplify safe denominator handling and often produces cleaner logic.
review_note: Use / when denominator is guaranteed non-zero or alternate handling is intentional.

title: VALUES plus defensive single-selection logic where SELECTEDVALUE is clearer
rationale: SELECTEDVALUE can simplify common single-value selection patterns.
review_note: Complex multi-select behavior may require VALUES.

title: COUNT used where COUNTROWS over a table better expresses row counting intent
rationale: COUNTROWS is typically clearer for counting table rows.
review_note: COUNT is appropriate when counting nonblank numeric/date values in a column.

title: Measure converts BLANK to zero without a business requirement
rationale: Returning zero instead of BLANK can densify visuals and change user interpretation.
evidence_required: DAX COALESCE/IF patterns and visual behavior
review_note: Zero may be required by the business definition.

title: Complex iterator over a high-cardinality table
rationale: Iterators over large tables can become expensive and may need model or DAX redesign.
evidence_required: Iterator functions, table cardinality, performance traces
review_note: Some calculations inherently require iterators; measure performance before changing.

title: Deeply nested IF/SWITCH logic with duplicated branches
rationale: Highly nested conditional logic increases maintenance risk and can be refactored.
review_note: Complex business logic may legitimately require branching.

title: Hard-coded business constants embedded across multiple measures
rationale: Scattered constants make business logic harder to govern and update.
review_note: A one-off stable constant may be acceptable.

title: Measure naming does not communicate business meaning
rationale: Clear measure names improve report authoring and maintainability.
review_note: Short technical names may be acceptable in tightly controlled models.
